20	    Block,

22	
23	impl GateDecision {
24	    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
25	        match self {
26	            Self::Pass => "pass",
27	            Self::Block => "block",
28	        }
29	    }
30	
31	    fn in_policy(self) -> bool {
32	        matches!(self, Self::Pass)
33	    }

43	impl ScopeStatus {

166	            cross_refs: Vec::new(),
167	            max_identical_calls: 1_000_000,

171	
172	    fn is_unavailable(&self) -> bool {
173	        self.blocked_patterns.is_empty()
174	            && self.blocked_values.is_empty()
175	            && self.requires.is_empty()
176	            && self.cross_refs.is_empty()

284	#[derive(Debug)]
285	pub struct GateEngine {
286	    config: GateConfig,
287	    signing_key: SigningKey,
288	    verifying_key: VerifyingKey,
289	    agent: String,
290	    plan_id: String,
291	}
292	
293	impl GateEngine {
294	    pub fn tier1() -> Arc<Self> {
295	        Self::new(
296	            GateConfig::tier1(),
297	            "tier1-gate",
298	            "tier1-correctness-suite",
299	        )
300	    }
301	
302	    pub fn with_config(config: GateConfig, agent: &str, plan_id: &str) -> Arc<Self> {
303	        Self::new(config, agent, plan_id)
304	    }
305	
306	    fn new(config: GateConfig, agent: &str, plan_id: &str) -> Arc<Self> {
307	        let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[23; 32]);
308	        Arc::new(Self {
309	            config,
310	            verifying_key: signing_key.verifying_key(),
311	            signing_key,
312	            agent: agent.to_owned(),
313	            plan_id: plan_id.to_owned(),
314	        })
315	    }
316	
317	    pub fn open_session(self: &Arc<Self>, session_id: &str) -> GateSession {
318	        GateSession {
319	            engine: Arc::clone(self),
320	            inner: Arc::new(Mutex::new(SessionState::new(session_id))),
321	        }
322	    }
323	
324	    pub fn verifying_key(&self) -> &VerifyingKey {
325	        &self.verifying_key
326	    }

329	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
330	pub struct GateSession {
331	    engine: Arc<GateEngine>,
332	    inner: Arc<Mutex<SessionState>>,
333	}
334	
335	impl GateSession {
336	    pub fn evaluate(&self, call: ToolCall) -> AerfResult<GateOutcome> {
337	        let mut state = self.inner.lock().map_err(|_| lock_err("gate session"))?;
338	        if let Some(reason) = &state.recording_failure {
339	            return Err(AerfError::Io(std::io::Error::other(format!(
340	                "receipt recording disabled: {reason}"
341	            ))));
342	        }
343	        let call_key = call_key(&call.tool, &call.args)?;
344	        let identical_calls = state.call_count(&call_key);
345	        let scope_status = scope_status(&call);
346	        let decision = decide(&self.engine.config, &state, &call, identical_calls);
347	        let stub_result = if matches!(decision.0, GateDecision::Pass) {
348	            Some(simulate_tool(&call))
349	        } else {
350	            None
351	        };
352	        let receipt = build_receipt(&self.engine, &state, &call, ReceiptDraft {
353	            decision: decision.0,
354	            reason: decision.1.clone(),
355	            scope_status,
356	            stub_result: stub_result.as_ref(),
357	            loop_count: identical_calls + 1,
358	        })?;
359	        let summary = DecisionSummary {
360	            actor: receipt.agent.clone(),
361	            tool: call.tool.clone(),
362	            args: call.args.clone(),
363	            decision: decision.0,
364	            reason: decision.1.clone(),
365	            scope_status,
366	            receipt_hash: receipt.chain_hash()?,
367	            policy_reason: receipt.policy_reason.clone(),
368	            compliance_tags: receipt.compliance_tags.clone(),
369	        };
370	        state.receipts.push(receipt.clone());
371	        state.decisions.push(summary);
372	        state.record_call(call_key);
373	        if matches!(decision.0, GateDecision::Pass) {
374	            state.observe_passed_call(&self.engine.config, &call);
375	        }
376	        state.next_seq += 1;
377	        Ok(GateOutcome {
378	            decision: decision.0,
379	            reason: decision.1,
380	            scope_status,
381	            stub_result,
382	            receipt,
383	        })
384	    }
385	
386	    pub fn fail_recording(&self, reason: &str) -> AerfResult<GateOutcome> {
387	        let mut state = self.inner.lock().map_err(|_| lock_err("gate session"))?;
388	        if let Some(existing) = &state.recording_failure {
389	            return Err(AerfError::Io(std::io::Error::other(format!(
390	                "receipt recording already disabled: {existing}"
391	            ))));
392	        }
393	        let call = ToolCall::new("recording_interrupted", json!({ "reason": reason }));
394	        let stub_result = json!({
395	            "incomplete": true,
396	            "reason": reason
397	        });
398	        let receipt = build_receipt(&self.engine, &state, &call, ReceiptDraft {
399	            decision: GateDecision::Block,
400	            reason: format!("receipt recording interrupted: {reason}"),
401	            scope_status: ScopeStatus::Unscoped,
402	            stub_result: Some(&stub_result),
403	            loop_count: 1,
404	        })?;
405	        let summary = DecisionSummary {
406	            actor: receipt.agent.clone(),
407	            tool: call.tool.clone(),
408	            args: call.args.clone(),
409	            decision: GateDecision::Block,
410	            reason: format!("receipt recording interrupted: {reason}"),
411	            scope_status: ScopeStatus::Unscoped,
412	            receipt_hash: receipt.chain_hash()?,
413	            policy_reason: receipt.policy_reason.clone(),
414	            compliance_tags: receipt.compliance_tags.clone(),
415	        };
416	        let call_key = call_key(&call.tool, &call.args)?;
417	        state.receipts.push(receipt.clone());
418	        state.decisions.push(summary);
419	        state.record_call(call_key);
420	        state.next_seq += 1;
421	        state.recording_failure = Some(reason.to_owned());
422	        Ok(GateOutcome {
423	            decision: GateDecision::Block,
424	            reason: format!("receipt recording interrupted: {reason}"),
425	            scope_status: ScopeStatus::Unscoped,
426	            stub_result: Some(stub_result),
427	            receipt,
428	        })
429	    }
430	
431	    pub fn record_unreceipted_action(&self, call: ToolCall) -> AerfResult<Value> {
432	        let mut state = self.inner.lock().map_err(|_| lock_err("gate session"))?;
433	        if state.recording_failure.is_none() {
434	            return Err(AerfError::Io(std::io::Error::other(
435	                "receipt recording is still enabled",
436	            )));
437	        }
438	        let stub_result = simulate_tool(&call);
439	        state.unreceipted_actions.push(UnrecordedAction {
440	            actor: call
441	                .actor
442	                .unwrap_or_else(|| self.engine.agent.clone()),
443	            tool: call.tool,
444	            summary: summarize_unrecorded_args(&call.args),
445	        });
446	        Ok(stub_result)
447	    }
448	
449	    pub fn decisions(&self) -> AerfResult<Vec<DecisionSummary>> {
450	        let state = self.inner.lock().map_err(|_| lock_err("gate session"))?;
451	        Ok(state.decisions.clone())
452	    }
453	
454	    pub fn receipts(&self) -> AerfResult<Vec<Receipt>> {
455	        let state = self.inner.lock().map_err(|_| lock_err("gate session"))?;
456	        Ok(state.receipts.clone())
457	    }
458	
459	    pub fn verify_receipts(&self) -> AerfResult<Vec<VerificationSummary>> {
460	        let state = self.inner.lock().map_err(|_| lock_err("gate session"))?;
461	        Ok(state
462	            .receipts
463	            .iter()
464	            .map(|receipt| {
465	                let verification = verify_aerf_receipt(
466	                    receipt,
467	                    self.engine.verifying_key(),
468	                    VerifyOptions::default(),
469	                );
470	                VerificationSummary {
471	                    receipt_signed: !receipt.signature.is_empty(),
472	                    receipt_verifies: verification.ok,
473	                }
474	            })
475	            .collect())
476	    }
477	
478	    pub fn recording_status(&self) -> AerfResult<RecordingStatus> {
479	        let state = self.inner.lock().map_err(|_| lock_err("gate session"))?;
480	        Ok(RecordingStatus {
481	            incomplete: state.recording_failure.is_some(),
482	            failure_reason: state.recording_failure.clone(),
483	            dropped_actions: state.unreceipted_actions.len(),
484	            dropped_action_summaries: state
485	                .unreceipted_actions
486	                .iter()
487	                .map(|action| format!("{}:{} {}", action.actor, action.tool, action.summary))
488	                .collect(),
489	        })
490	    }
491	}
492	
493	#[derive(Debug)]
494	struct SessionState {
495	    session_id: String,
496	    next_seq: u64,
497	    started_at: chrono::DateTime<Utc>,
498	    receipts: Vec<Receipt>,
499	    decisions: Vec<DecisionSummary>,
500	    call_counts: HashMap<String, usize>,
501	    observed_tools: HashSet<String>,
502	    cross_ref_values: HashMap<String, HashSet<String>>,
503	    recording_failure: Option<String>,
504	    unreceipted_actions: Vec<UnrecordedAction>,
505	}
506	
507	impl SessionState {
508	    fn new(session_id: &str) -> Self {
509	        Self {
510	            session_id: session_id.to_owned(),
511	            next_seq: 1,
512	            started_at: Utc::now(),
513	            receipts: Vec::new(),
514	            decisions: Vec::new(),
515	            call_counts: HashMap::new(),
516	            observed_tools: HashSet::new(),
517	            cross_ref_values: HashMap::new(),
518	            recording_failure: None,
519	            unreceipted_actions: Vec::new(),
520	        }
521	    }
522	
523	    fn call_count(&self, key: &str) -> usize {
524	        self.call_counts.get(key).copied().unwrap_or_default()
525	    }
526	
527	    fn record_call(&mut self, key: String) {
528	        *self.call_counts.entry(key).or_insert(0) += 1;
529	    }
530	
531	    fn observe_passed_call(&mut self, config: &GateConfig, call: &ToolCall) {
532	        self.observed_tools.insert(call.tool.clone());
533	        for rule in &config.cross_refs {
534	            if rule.prior_tool != call.tool {
535	                continue;
536	            }
537	            let Some(value) = string_field(&call.args, &rule.prior_field) else {
538	                continue;
539	            };
540	            self.cross_ref_values
541	                .entry(cross_ref_key(&rule.prior_tool, &rule.prior_field))
542	                .or_default()
543	                .insert(value.to_owned());
544	        }
545	    }
546	}
547	
548	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
549	struct UnrecordedAction {
550	    actor: String,
551	    tool: String,
552	    summary: String,
553	}
554	
555	struct ReceiptDraft<'a> {
556	    decision: GateDecision,
557	    reason: String,
558	    scope_status: ScopeStatus,
559	    stub_result: Option<&'a Value>,
560	    loop_count: usize,
561	}
562	
563	fn decide(
564	    config: &GateConfig,
565	    state: &SessionState,
566	    call: &ToolCall,
567	    identical_calls: usize,
568	) -> (GateDecision, String) {
569	    if config.is_unavailable() {
570	        eprintln!("agentmint: gate rules failed to load, blocking all actions until resolved");
571	        return (
572	            GateDecision::Block,
573	            "gate unavailable: no enforcement rules loaded".to_owned(),
574	        );
575	    }
576	
577	    if identical_calls >= config.max_identical_calls {
578	        return (
579	            GateDecision::Block,
580	            format!(
581	                "loop breaker blocked identical {tool} call #{count} after max_identical_calls={max}",
582	                tool = call.tool,
583	                count = identical_calls + 1,
584	                max = config.max_identical_calls
585	            ),
586	        );
587	    }
588	
589	    for rule in &config.blocked_patterns {
590	        if rule.tool != call.tool {
591	            continue;
592	        }
593	        let Some(value) = string_field(&call.args, &rule.field) else {
594	            continue;
595	        };
596	        if let Some(pattern) = rule.patterns.iter().find(|pattern| matches_pattern(pattern, value)) {
597	            return (
598	                GateDecision::Block,
599	                format!(
600	                    "{tool}.{field} matched blocked pattern `{pattern}`",
601	                    tool = call.tool,
602	                    field = rule.field
603	                ),
604	            );
605	        }
606	    }
607	
608	    for rule in &config.blocked_values {
609	        if rule.tool != call.tool {
610	            continue;
611	        }
612	        let Some(value) = string_field(&call.args, &rule.field) else {
613	            continue;
614	        };
615	        if let Some(blocked_value) = rule.values.iter().find(|blocked_value| blocked_value.as_str() == value) {
616	            return (
617	                GateDecision::Block,
618	                format!(
619	                    "{tool}.{field} matched blocked value `{blocked_value}`",
620	                    tool = call.tool,
621	                    field = rule.field
622	                ),
623	            );
624	        }
625	    }
626	
627	    for rule in &config.requires {
628	        if rule.tool != call.tool {
629	            continue;
630	        }
631	        for required_tool in &rule.required_tools {
632	            let seen = state.observed_tools.contains(required_tool);
633	            if !seen {
634	                return (
635	                    GateDecision::Block,
636	                    format!("{tool} requires prior `{required_tool}` in the same session", tool = call.tool),
637	                );
638	            }
639	        }
640	    }
641	
642	    for rule in &config.cross_refs {
643	        if rule.tool != call.tool {
644	            continue;
645	        }
646	        let Some(value) = string_field(&call.args, &rule.field) else {
647	            continue;
648	        };
649	        let prior_values = state
650	            .cross_ref_values
651	            .get(&cross_ref_key(&rule.prior_tool, &rule.prior_field));
652	        let matches_prior = prior_values.is_some_and(|values| values.contains(value));
653	        let related_write = call.tool == "write_file"
654	            && rule.field == "path"
655	            && prior_values.is_some_and(|values| has_related_prior_read(values, value));
656	        if related_write {
657	            continue;
658	        }
659	        if !matches_prior {
660	            return (
661	                GateDecision::Block,
662	                format!(
663	                    "{tool}.{field} failed cross_ref against prior {prior_tool}.{prior_field}",
664	                    tool = call.tool,
665	                    field = rule.field,
666	                    prior_tool = rule.prior_tool,
667	                    prior_field = rule.prior_field
668	                ),
669	            );
670	        }
671	    }
672	
673	    (GateDecision::Pass, "allowed".to_owned())
674	}
675	
676	fn build_receipt(
677	    engine: &GateEngine,
678	    state: &SessionState,
679	    call: &ToolCall,
680	    draft: ReceiptDraft<'_>,
681	) -> AerfResult<Receipt> {
682	    let evidence = json!({
683	        "tool": call.tool,
684	        "args": call.args,
685	        "result": draft.stub_result,
686	        "decision": draft.decision.as_str(),
687	        "reason": &draft.reason,
688	        "scope_status": draft.scope_status.as_str(),
689	        "task_scope": call.task_scope.as_ref().map(|scope| json!({
690	            "summary": scope.summary,
691	            "file_paths": scope.file_paths,
692	            "commands": scope.commands
693	        })),
694	        "requested_at": call.requested_at,
695	        "loop": {
696	            "count_for_pair": draft.loop_count,
697	            "max_identical_calls": engine.config.max_identical_calls
698	        }
699	    });
700	    let evidence_hash_sha512 = sha512_hex(&serde_json::to_vec(&evidence)?);
701	    let observed_at = (state.started_at + Duration::milliseconds(state.next_seq as i64))
702	        .to_rfc3339_opts(SecondsFormat::Millis, true);
703	    let mut receipt_value = json!({
704	        "id": Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
705	        "type": "notarised_evidence",
706	        "plan_id": engine.plan_id,
707	        "agent": call.actor.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| engine.agent.clone()),
708	        "action": call.tool,
709	        "in_policy": draft.decision.in_policy(),
710	        "policy_reason": scoped_reason(&draft.reason, draft.scope_status),
711	        "evidence_hash_sha512": evidence_hash_sha512,
712	        "evidence": evidence,
713	        "observed_at": observed_at,
714	        "key_id": key_id(engine.verifying_key()),
715	        "policy_hash": engine.config.policy_hash,
716	        "session_id": state.session_id,
717	        "seq": state.next_seq,
718	        "compliance_tags": compliance_tags(call, draft.decision, draft.scope_status),
719	        "impact_tags": Vec::<String>::new(),
720	    });
721	
722	    if let Some(previous_receipt) = state.receipts.last() {
723	        receipt_value["previous_receipt_hash"] = Value::String(previous_receipt.chain_hash()?);
724	    }
725	
726	    let signature = sign_stripped(&receipt_value, &engine.signing_key)?;
727	    receipt_value["signature"] = Value::String(signature);
728	    Receipt::from_value(receipt_value)
729	}
730	
731	fn scoped_reason(reason: &str, scope_status: ScopeStatus) -> String {
732	    match scope_status {
733	        ScopeStatus::OutOfScope => format!("{reason}; scope=outside_task"),
734	        ScopeStatus::InScope => format!("{reason}; scope=within_task"),
735	        ScopeStatus::Unscoped => reason.to_owned(),
736	    }
737	}
738	
739	fn simulate_tool(call: &ToolCall) -> Value {
740	    match &call.planned_result {
741	        PlannedResult::Custom(value) => value.clone(),
742	        PlannedResult::RunTests { passed, failed } => json!({
743	            "passed": passed,
744	            "failed": failed
745	        }),
746	        PlannedResult::Default => default_tool_result(call),
747	    }
748	}
749	
750	fn default_tool_result(call: &ToolCall) -> Value {
751	    match call.tool.as_str() {
752	        "read_file" => json!({
753	            "path": string_field(&call.args, "path").unwrap_or_default(),
754	            "contents": format!("// contents of {}", string_field(&call.args, "path").unwrap_or_default())
755	        }),
756	        "write_file" => json!({
757	            "path": string_field(&call.args, "path").unwrap_or_default(),
758	            "written": true
759	        }),
760	        "run_command" => json!({
761	            "command": string_field(&call.args, "command").unwrap_or_default(),
762	            "exit_code": 0
763	        }),
764	        "git_commit" => json!({
765	            "committed": true,
766	            "message": string_field(&call.args, "message").unwrap_or_default()
767	        }),
768	        "git_push" => json!({
769	            "pushed": true,
770	            "branch": string_field(&call.args, "branch").unwrap_or_default()
771	        }),
772	        "run_tests" => json!({
773	            "passed": 1,
774	            "failed": 0
775	        }),
776	        _ => Value::Object(Default::default()),
777	    }
778	}
779	
780	fn scope_status(call: &ToolCall) -> ScopeStatus {
781	    let Some(scope) = &call.task_scope else {
782	        return ScopeStatus::Unscoped;
783	    };
784	
785	    match call.tool.as_str() {
786	        "read_file" | "write_file" => {
787	            let Some(path) = string_field(&call.args, "path") else {
788	                return ScopeStatus::OutOfScope;
789	            };
790	            if scope.file_paths.iter().any(|allowed| allowed == path) {
791	                ScopeStatus::InScope
792	            } else {
793	                ScopeStatus::OutOfScope
794	            }
795	        }
796	        "run_command" => {
797	            let Some(command) = string_field(&call.args, "command") else {
798	                return ScopeStatus::OutOfScope;
799	            };
800	            if scope.commands.iter().any(|allowed| allowed == command) {
801	                ScopeStatus::InScope
802	            } else {
803	                ScopeStatus::OutOfScope
804	            }
805	        }
806	        _ => ScopeStatus::InScope,
807	    }
808	}
809	
810	fn string_field<'a>(value: &'a Value, field: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
811	    value.get(field)?.as_str()
812	}
813	
814	fn has_related_prior_read(prior_paths: &HashSet<String>, candidate: &str) -> bool {
815	    prior_paths.iter().any(|prior_path| paths_are_related(prior_path, candidate))
816	}
817	
818	fn paths_are_related(prior_path: &str, candidate: &str) -> bool {
819	    let Some((prior_dir, prior_file)) = split_path(prior_path) else {
820	        return false;
821	    };
822	    let Some((candidate_dir, candidate_file)) = split_path(candidate) else {
823	        return false;
824	    };
825	    if prior_dir != candidate_dir {
826	        return false;
827	    }
828	
829	    let prior_stem = file_stem(prior_file);
830	    let candidate_stem = file_stem(candidate_file);
831	    if prior_stem == candidate_stem {
832	        return true;
833	    }
834	
835	    prior_stem.starts_with(candidate_stem) || candidate_stem.starts_with(prior_stem)
836	}
837	
838	fn split_path(path: &str) -> Option<(&str, &str)> {
839	    let (dir, file) = path.rsplit_once('/')?;
840	    if file.is_empty() {
841	        return None;
842	    }
843	    Some((dir, file))
844	}
845	
846	fn file_stem(file_name: &str) -> &str {
847	    file_name
848	        .split_once('.')
849	        .map(|(stem, _)| stem)
850	        .unwrap_or(file_name)
851	}
852	
853	fn matches_pattern(pattern: &str, value: &str) -> bool {
854	    if !pattern.contains('*') {
855	        return value.contains(pattern);
856	    }
857	
858	    let parts: Vec<&str> = pattern.split('*').collect();
859	    let anchored_start = !pattern.starts_with('*');
860	    let anchored_end = !pattern.ends_with('*');
861	    let mut offset = 0usize;
862	
863	    for (index, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
864	        if part.is_empty() {
865	            continue;
866	        }
867	        let remainder = &value[offset..];
868	        let Some(found) = remainder.find(part) else {
869	            return false;
870	        };
871	        if index == 0 && anchored_start && found != 0 {
872	            return false;
873	        }
874	        offset += found + part.len();
875	    }
876	
877	    if anchored_end {
878	        if let Some(last) = parts.iter().rev().find(|part| !part.is_empty()) {
879	            return value.ends_with(last);
880	        }
881	    }
882	
883	    true
884	}
885	
886	fn sha512_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
887	    let mut hasher = Sha512::new();
888	    hasher.update(bytes);
889	    hex::encode(hasher.finalize())
890	}
891	
892	pub fn verify_receipt_set(
893	    receipts: &[Receipt],
894	    verifying_key: &VerifyingKey,
895	) -> AerfResult<Vec<VerificationSummary>> {
896	    receipts
897	        .iter()
898	        .map(|receipt| {
899	            let verification = verify_aerf_receipt(receipt, verifying_key, VerifyOptions::default());
900	            Ok(VerificationSummary {
901	                receipt_signed: !receipt.signature.is_empty(),
902	                receipt_verifies: verification.ok,
903	            })
904	        })
905	        .collect()
906	}
907	
908	pub fn group_decisions_by_reason(decisions: &[DecisionSummary]) -> HashMap<String, usize> {
909	    let mut counts = HashMap::new();
910	    for decision in decisions {
911	        *counts.entry(decision.reason.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
912	    }
913	    counts
914	}
915	
916	fn lock_err(name: &str) -> AerfError {
917	    AerfError::Io(std::io::Error::other(format!("{name} lock poisoned")))
918	}
919	
920	fn summarize_unrecorded_args(args: &Value) -> String {
921	    if let Some(path) = string_field(args, "path") {
922	        return format!("path={path}");
923	    }
924	    if let Some(command) = string_field(args, "command") {
925	        return format!("command={command}");
926	    }
927	    if let Some(branch) = string_field(args, "branch") {
928	        return format!("branch={branch}");
929	    }
930	    if let Some(message) = string_field(args, "message") {
931	        return format!("message={message}");
932	    }
933	    args.to_string()
934	}
935	
936	fn compliance_tags(call: &ToolCall, decision: GateDecision, scope_status: ScopeStatus) -> Vec<String> {
937	    let mut tags = vec![
938	        format!("gate:{}", decision.as_str()),
939	        scope_status.tag().to_owned(),
940	    ];
941	    if call.tool == "recording_interrupted" {
942	        tags.push("recording:interrupted".to_owned());
943	    }
944	    tags
945	}

947	fn call_key(tool: &str, args: &Value) -> AerfResult<String> {
948	    Ok(format!("{tool}:{}", serde_json::to_string(args)?))
949	}

951	fn cross_ref_key(tool: &str, field: &str) -> String {
952	    format!("{tool}.{field}")
953	}

1101	        assert_eq!(status.dropped_actions, 1);
1102	        assert_eq!(
1103	            status.dropped_action_summaries,
1104	            vec!["tier1-gate:run_command command=echo post-gap".to_owned()]
1105	        );
1106	        Ok(())

1	//! Canonical JSON encoding and hashing for AERF payloads.
2	//! Used by: signature, chain, and Merkle verification.
3	
4	use std::cmp::Ordering;
5	
6	use serde_json::{Map, Number, Value};
7	use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
8	use unicode_normalization::UnicodeNormalization;
9	
10	use crate::aerf::{AerfError, AerfResult};
11	
12	const MAX_SAFE_INTEGER: i128 = 9_007_199_254_740_991;
13	
14	#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
15	enum NumberMode {
16	    Strict,
17	    Verbatim,
18	}
19	
20	pub fn canonicalize(value: &Value) -> AerfResult<String> {
21	    encode(value, "$", NumberMode::Strict)
22	}
23	
24	pub(crate) fn canonicalize_verbatim(value: &Value) -> AerfResult<String> {
25	    encode(value, "$", NumberMode::Verbatim)
26	}
27	
28	pub fn sha256_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
29	    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
30	    hasher.update(bytes);
31	    hex::encode(hasher.finalize())
32	}
33	
34	fn encode(value: &Value, path: &str, mode: NumberMode) -> AerfResult<String> {
35	    match value {
36	        Value::Null => Ok("null".to_owned()),
37	        Value::Bool(true) => Ok("true".to_owned()),
38	        Value::Bool(false) => Ok("false".to_owned()),
39	        Value::String(string) => Ok(encode_string(string)),
40	        Value::Number(number) => encode_number(number, path, mode),
41	        Value::Array(values) => encode_array(values, path, mode),
42	        Value::Object(object) => encode_object(object, path, mode),
43	    }
44	}
45	
46	fn encode_array(values: &[Value], path: &str, mode: NumberMode) -> AerfResult<String> {
47	    let mut out = String::from("[");
48	    for (index, value) in values.iter().enumerate() {
49	        if index > 0 {
50	            out.push(',');
51	        }
52	        out.push_str(&encode(value, &format!("{path}[{index}]"), mode)?);
53	    }
54	    out.push(']');
55	    Ok(out)
56	}
57	
58	fn encode_object(object: &Map<String, Value>, path: &str, mode: NumberMode) -> AerfResult<String> {
59	    let mut keys = Vec::with_capacity(object.len());
60	    for raw in object.keys() {
61	        let normalized = raw.nfc().collect::<String>();
62	        keys.push((raw.as_str(), normalized));
63	    }
64	
65	    keys.sort_by(|left, right| compare_code_points(&left.1, &right.1));
66	
67	    for pair in keys.windows(2) {
68	        if pair[0].1 == pair[1].1 {
69	            return Err(AerfError::DuplicateNormalizedKey {
70	                path: path.to_owned(),
71	                key: pair[1].0.to_owned(),
72	            });
73	        }
74	    }
75	
76	    let mut out = String::from("{");
77	    for (index, (raw, normalized)) in keys.iter().enumerate() {
78	        if index > 0 {
79	            out.push(',');
80	        }
81	        out.push_str(&encode_string(normalized));
82	        out.push(':');
83	        let child_path = join_key(path, normalized);
84	        let value = object
85	            .get(*raw)
86	            .ok_or_else(|| AerfError::UnsupportedValue {
87	                path: child_path.clone(),
88	                kind: "missing object value".to_owned(),
89	            })?;
90	        out.push_str(&encode(value, &child_path, mode)?);
91	    }
92	    out.push('}');
93	    Ok(out)
94	}
95	
96	fn encode_string(value: &str) -> String {
97	    let mut out = String::from("\"");
98	    for ch in value.nfc() {
99	        match ch {
100	            '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
101	            '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
102	            '\u{0008}' => out.push_str("\\b"),
103	            '\u{000C}' => out.push_str("\\f"),
104	            '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
105	            '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
106	            '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
107	            _ if u32::from(ch) <= 0x1f => {
108	                out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", u32::from(ch)));
109	            }
110	            _ => out.push(ch),
111	        }
112	    }
113	    out.push('"');
114	    out
115	}
116	
117	fn encode_number(number: &Number, path: &str, mode: NumberMode) -> AerfResult<String> {
118	    let lexeme = number.to_string();
119	    if matches!(mode, NumberMode::Verbatim) {
120	        return Ok(lexeme);
121	    }
122	
123	    if let Some(integer) = parse_plain_integer(&lexeme, path)? {
124	        return Ok(integer.to_string());
125	    }
126	
127	    let value = lexeme
128	        .parse::<f64>()
129	        .map_err(|_| AerfError::CanonicalNumber {
130	            path: path.to_owned(),
131	            message: format!("Invalid number ({lexeme})"),
132	        })?;
133	
134	    if !value.is_finite() {
135	        return Err(AerfError::CanonicalNumber {
136	            path: path.to_owned(),
137	            message: format!("Non-finite number ({lexeme})"),
138	        });
139	    }
140	
141	    if value == 0.0 && lexeme.starts_with('-') {
142	        return Ok("0".to_owned());
143	    }
144	
145	    if value.fract() != 0.0 {
146	        return Err(AerfError::CanonicalNumber {
147	            path: path.to_owned(),
148	            message: format!(
149	                "Non-integer finite number ({lexeme}): canonical JSON cannot round-trip fractional numbers"
150	            ),
151	        });
152	    }
153	
154	    if value.abs() > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER as f64 {
155	        return Err(AerfError::CanonicalNumber {
156	            path: path.to_owned(),
157	            message: format!("Unsafe integer ({lexeme}): exceeds Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER"),
158	        });
159	    }
160	
161	    Ok(format!("{value:.0}"))
162	}
163	
164	fn parse_plain_integer(lexeme: &str, path: &str) -> AerfResult<Option<i128>> {
165	    if lexeme.contains('.') || lexeme.contains('e') || lexeme.contains('E') {
166	        return Ok(None);
167	    }
168	
169	    let integer = lexeme
170	        .parse::<i128>()
171	        .map_err(|_| AerfError::CanonicalNumber {
172	            path: path.to_owned(),
173	            message: format!("Invalid integer ({lexeme})"),
174	        })?;
175	
176	    if integer.abs() > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER {
177	        return Err(AerfError::CanonicalNumber {
178	            path: path.to_owned(),
179	            message: format!("Unsafe integer ({lexeme}): exceeds Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER"),
180	        });
181	    }
182	
183	    Ok(Some(integer))
184	}
185	
186	fn compare_code_points(left: &str, right: &str) -> Ordering {
187	    let mut left_chars = left.chars();
188	    let mut right_chars = right.chars();
189	
190	    loop {
191	        match (left_chars.next(), right_chars.next()) {
192	            (Some(a), Some(b)) => {
193	                let ordering = u32::from(a).cmp(&u32::from(b));
194	                if ordering != Ordering::Equal {
195	                    return ordering;
196	                }
197	            }
198	            (None, Some(_)) => return Ordering::Less,
199	            (Some(_), None) => return Ordering::Greater,
200	            (None, None) => return Ordering::Equal,
201	        }
202	    }
203	}
204	
205	fn join_key(path: &str, key: &str) -> String {
206	    if path == "$" {
207	        format!("$.{key}")
208	    } else {
209	        format!("{path}.{key}")
210	    }
211	}
212	
213	#[cfg(test)]
214	mod tests {
215	    use serde_json::json;
216	
217	    use super::{canonicalize, canonicalize_verbatim};
218	
219	    #[test]
220	    fn sorts_keys_and_normalizes_strings() {
221	        let value = json!({
222	            "e\u{301}": "Ame\u{301}lie",
223	            "a": 1
224	        });
225	
226	        let canonical = canonicalize(&value).expect("canonical");
227	
228	        assert_eq!(canonical, "{\"a\":1,\"é\":\"Amélie\"}");
229	    }
230	
231	    #[test]
232	    fn replays_verbatim_number_lexemes() {
233	        let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str("{\"amount\":1250.0}").expect("parse");
234	
235	        let canonical = canonicalize_verbatim(&value).expect("canonical");
236	
237	        assert_eq!(canonical, "{\"amount\":1250.0}");
238	    }
239	}

109	    let session = engine.open_session("normal-bugfix");
110	    let _ = session.evaluate(ToolCall::new("read_file", json!({ "path": "src/app.ts" })))?;
111	    let _ = session.evaluate(ToolCall::new("write_file", json!({ "path": "src/app.ts" })))?;
112	    let _ = session.evaluate(
113	        ToolCall::new("run_tests", json!({})).with_planned_result(PlannedResult::RunTests {
114	            passed: 24,
115	            failed: 0,
116	        }),
117	    )?;
118	    let _ = session.evaluate(ToolCall::new("git_commit", json!({ "message": "fix bug" })))?;
119	    let _ = session.evaluate(ToolCall::new("git_push", json!({ "branch": "feature/fix" })))?;
120	    let check = inspect_session(&session, engine)?;
121	
122	    Ok((
123	        ScenarioRow {
124	            name: "normal-bugfix",
125	            expected: "pass every step",
126	            actual: "PASS all 5 calls".to_owned(),
127	            receipt_signed: yes_no(all_signed(&check.receipts)),
128	            receipt_verifies: yes_no(all_verified(&check.receipts, engine)),
129	            replay_or_novel: "NOVEL",
130	            relevance: "FOUNDER-RELEVANT",
131	        },
132	        check,
133	    ))
134	}

213	    };

215	        "blocked on write_file(src/other.ts) because write_file.path had no matching prior read_file.path"
216	            .to_owned()
217	    } else {
218	        "passed write_file(src/other.ts) and only annotated the mismatch in the receipt".to_owned()
219	    };
220	
221	    Ok((
222	        ScenarioRow {
223	            name: "collateral-edit",
224	            expected: "observe cross_ref behavior",
225	            actual,
226	            receipt_signed: yes_no(all_signed(&check.receipts)),
227	            receipt_verifies: yes_no(all_verified(&check.receipts, engine)),
228	            replay_or_novel: "NOVEL",

230	        },

232	    ))
233	}

339	fn benign_scope_creep(
340	    engine: &Arc<GateEngine>,
341	) -> Result<(ScenarioRow, String), Box<dyn Error>> {
342	    let scope = TaskScope {
343	        summary: "fix the failing test in src/app.ts".to_owned(),
344	        file_paths: vec!["src/app.ts".to_owned()],
345	        commands: vec![],
346	    };
347	    let session = engine.open_session("benign-scope-creep");
348	    let _ = session.evaluate(
349	        ToolCall::new("read_file", json!({ "path": "src/app.ts" })).with_scope(scope.clone()),
350	    )?;
351	    let _ = session.evaluate(
352	        ToolCall::new("write_file", json!({ "path": "src/app.ts" })).with_scope(scope.clone()),
353	    )?;
354	    let unrelated_write = session.evaluate(
355	        ToolCall::new("write_file", json!({ "path": "src/unrelated_config.ts" }))
356	            .with_scope(scope.clone()),
357	    )?;
358	    let cleanup = session.evaluate(
359	        ToolCall::new(
360	            "run_command",
361	            json!({ "command": "find node_modules/.cache -type f -delete" }),
362	        )
363	        .with_scope(scope),
364	    )?;
365	
366	    let check = inspect_session(&session, engine)?;
367	    let outside_scope = check
368	        .decisions
369	        .iter()
370	        .filter(|decision| matches!(decision.scope_status, ScopeStatus::OutOfScope))
371	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
372	    assert_eq!(outside_scope.len(), 2);
373	    for decision in outside_scope {
374	        assert!(decision.policy_reason.contains("scope=outside_task"));
375	        assert!(decision.compliance_tags.iter().any(|tag| tag == "scope:outside_task"));
376	    }
377	    assert_eq!(cleanup.decision, GateDecision::Pass);
378	
379	    let actual = if matches!(unrelated_write.decision, GateDecision::Block) {
380	        "BLOCK out-of-scope write_file(src/unrelated_config.ts); PASS out-of-scope cleanup command with receipt scope tags"
381	            .to_owned()
382	    } else {
383	        "PASS out-of-scope write_file(src/unrelated_config.ts); PASS out-of-scope cleanup command with receipt scope tags"
384	            .to_owned()
385	    };
386	    let note = if matches!(unrelated_write.decision, GateDecision::Block) {
387	        "scenario 10 scope receipts clearly marked write_file(src/unrelated_config.ts) and run_command(find node_modules/.cache -type f -delete) as outside task scope; the write was blocked by cross_ref mismatch"
388	            .to_owned()
389	    } else {
390	        "scenario 10 scope receipts clearly marked write_file(src/unrelated_config.ts) and run_command(find node_modules/.cache -type f -delete) as outside task scope; the write still passed"
391	            .to_owned()
392	    };
393	
394	    Ok((
395	        ScenarioRow {
396	            name: "benign-scope-creep",
397	            expected: "observe cross_ref; scope tags required",
398	            actual,
399	            receipt_signed: yes_no(all_signed(&check.receipts)),
400	            receipt_verifies: yes_no(all_verified(&check.receipts, engine)),
401	            replay_or_novel: "REPLAY",
402	            relevance: "FOUNDER-RELEVANT",
403	        },
404	        note,
405	    ))
406	}
407	
408	fn cost_loop_runaway(
409	    engine: &Arc<GateEngine>,
410	) -> Result<(ScenarioRow, String), Box<dyn Error>> {
411	    let session = engine.open_session("cost-loop-runaway");
412	    for _ in 0..3 {
413	        let outcome = session.evaluate(
414	            ToolCall::new(
415	                "run_command",
416	                json!({ "command": "curl https://api.example/status" }),
417	            )
418	            .with_planned_result(PlannedResult::Custom(json!({
419	                "command": "curl https://api.example/status",
420	                "exit_code": 0,
421	                "body": ""
422	            }))),
423	        )?;
424	        assert_eq!(outcome.decision, GateDecision::Pass);
425	    }
426	    let blocked = session.evaluate(
427	        ToolCall::new(
428	            "run_command",
429	            json!({ "command": "curl https://api.example/status" }),
430	        )
431	        .with_planned_result(PlannedResult::Custom(json!({
432	            "command": "curl https://api.example/status",
433	            "exit_code": 0,
434	            "body": ""
435	        }))),
436	    )?;
437	    assert_eq!(blocked.decision, GateDecision::Block);
438	    assert_eq!(blocked.receipt.evidence["loop"]["count_for_pair"], json!(4));
439	    let check = inspect_session(&session, engine)?;
440	    let note =
441	        "scenario 11 blocking receipt recorded loop.count_for_pair=4 before the breaker cut off retries"
442	            .to_owned();
443	
444	    Ok((
445	        ScenarioRow {
446	            name: "cost-loop-runaway",
447	            expected: "loop breaker fires; receipt records cost count",
448	            actual: "BLOCK 4th identical curl status retry; receipt captured count=4".to_owned(),
449	            receipt_signed: yes_no(all_signed(&check.receipts)),
450	            receipt_verifies: yes_no(all_verified(&check.receipts, engine)),
451	            replay_or_novel: "NOVEL",
452	            relevance: "FOUNDER-RELEVANT",
453	        },
454	        note,
455	    ))
456	}
457	
458	fn concurrent_batch_writes(
459	    engine: &Arc<GateEngine>,
460	) -> Result<(ScenarioRow, SessionCheck), Box<dyn Error>> {
461	    let session = engine.open_session("concurrent-batch-writes");
462	    let _ = session.evaluate(
463	        ToolCall::new("read_file", json!({ "path": "src/shared.ts" }))
464	            .with_requested_at("2026-07-17T00:00:00.000Z"),
465	    )?;
466	
467	    let barrier = Arc::new(Barrier::new(2));
468	    let write_session = session.clone();
469	    let read_session = session.clone();
470	    let write_barrier = Arc::clone(&barrier);
471	    let read_barrier = Arc::clone(&barrier);
472	
473	    let write_thread = thread::spawn(move || {
474	        write_barrier.wait();
475	        write_session.evaluate(
476	            ToolCall::new("write_file", json!({ "path": "src/shared.ts" }))
477	                .with_requested_at("2026-07-17T00:00:00.001Z"),
478	        )
479	    });
480	
481	    let read_thread = thread::spawn(move || {
482	        read_barrier.wait();
483	        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
484	        read_session.evaluate(
485	            ToolCall::new("read_file", json!({ "path": "src/shared.ts" }))
486	                .with_requested_at("2026-07-17T00:00:00.001Z"),
487	        )
488	    });
489	
490	    let write_outcome = join_outcome(write_thread)?;
491	    let read_outcome = join_outcome(read_thread)?;
492	    assert_eq!(write_outcome.decision, GateDecision::Pass);
493	    assert_eq!(read_outcome.decision, GateDecision::Pass);
494	
495	    let check = inspect_session(&session, engine)?;
496	    assert_eq!(check.receipts.len(), 3);
497	    assert_eq!(check.receipts[1].seq, Some(2));
498	    assert_eq!(check.receipts[2].seq, Some(3));
499	    let previous_hash = check.receipts[1].chain_hash()?;
500	    assert_eq!(
501	        check.receipts[2].previous_receipt_hash.as_deref(),
502	        Some(previous_hash.as_str())
503	    );
504	
505	    Ok((
506	        ScenarioRow {
507	            name: "concurrent-batch-writes",
508	            expected: "parallel pair keeps ordered signed chain",
509	            actual: "PASS concurrent write/read batch; no seq collision or chain break".to_owned(),
510	            receipt_signed: yes_no(all_signed(&check.receipts)),
511	            receipt_verifies: yes_no(all_verified(&check.receipts, engine)),
512	            replay_or_novel: "NOVEL",
513	            relevance: "SECURITY-RESEARCH",
514	        },
515	        check,
516	    ))
517	}
518	
519	fn inspect_session(session: &GateSession, engine: &Arc<GateEngine>) -> Result<SessionCheck, Box<dyn Error>> {
520	    let receipts = session.receipts()?;
521	    let decisions = session.decisions()?;
522	    let chain = verify_aerf_chain(
523	        &receipts,
524	        VerifyChainOptions {
525	            issuer_public_key: Some(engine.verifying_key()),
526	        },
527	    );
528	    assert!(chain.valid);
529	    assert!(all_verified(&receipts, engine));
530	
531	    Ok(SessionCheck { receipts, decisions })
532	}
533	
534	fn all_signed(receipts: &[Receipt]) -> bool {
535	    receipts.iter().all(|receipt| !receipt.signature.is_empty())
536	}
537	
538	fn all_verified(receipts: &[Receipt], engine: &Arc<GateEngine>) -> bool {
539	    agentmint::aerf::gate::verify_receipt_set(receipts, engine.verifying_key())
540	        .map(|results| results.iter().all(|item| item.receipt_signed && item.receipt_verifies))
541	        .unwrap_or(false)
542	}
543	
544	fn yes_no(value: bool) -> &'static str {
545	    if value {
546	        "yes"
547	    } else {
548	        "no"
549	    }
550	}
551	
552	fn join_outcome(
553	    handle: thread::JoinHandle<agentmint::aerf::AerfResult<agentmint::aerf::gate::GateOutcome>>,
554	) -> Result<agentmint::aerf::gate::GateOutcome, Box<dyn Error>> {
555	    let outcome = handle
556	        .join()
557	        .map_err(|_| io::Error::other("scenario thread panicked"))??;
558	    Ok(outcome)
559	}

84	fn silent_enforcement_grade(engine: &Arc<GateEngine>) -> Result<&'static str, Box<dyn Error>> {
85	    let session = engine.open_session("p3-empty-rules");
86	    let destructive = session.evaluate(ToolCall::new(
87	        "run_command",
88	        json!({ "command": "rm -rf /" }),
89	    ))?;
90	    let credential = session.evaluate(ToolCall::new("read_file", json!({ "path": ".env" })))?;
91	
92	    let grade = if matches!(destructive.decision, GateDecision::Pass)
93	        && matches!(credential.decision, GateDecision::Pass)
94	        && !destructive.reason.contains("unavailable")
95	        && !credential.reason.contains("unavailable")
96	    {
97	        "SILENT-OPEN"
98	    } else {
99	        "LOUD-FAIL"
100	    };
101	
102	    Ok(grade)
103	}

250	
251	struct SingleCallScenario {
252	    session_id: &'static str,
253	    test_id: &'static str,
254	    category: &'static str,
255	    outcome_kind: OutcomeKind,
256	    rating_rule: RatingRule,
257	    note: &'static str,
258	    call: ToolCall,
259	}
260	
261	fn single_call_row(
262	    engine: &Arc<GateEngine>,
263	    scenario: SingleCallScenario,
264	) -> Result<RobustnessRow, Box<dyn Error>> {
265	    let session = engine.open_session(scenario.session_id);
266	    let outcome = session.evaluate(scenario.call)?;
267	    Ok(build_row(
268	        scenario.test_id,
269	        scenario.category,
270	        scenario.outcome_kind,
271	        outcome.decision,
272	        scenario.rating_rule,
273	        scenario.note,
274	    ))
275	}
276	
277	fn single_call_after_read(
278	    engine: &Arc<GateEngine>,
279	    session_id: &str,
280	    read_path: &str,
281	    test_id: &'static str,
282	    category: &'static str,
283	    write_path: &str,
284	    note: &'static str,
285	) -> Result<RobustnessRow, Box<dyn Error>> {
286	    let session = engine.open_session(session_id);
287	    let _ = session.evaluate(ToolCall::new("read_file", json!({ "path": read_path })))?;
288	    let outcome = session.evaluate(ToolCall::new("write_file", json!({ "path": write_path })))?;
289	    Ok(build_row(
290	        test_id,
291	        category,
292	        OutcomeKind::Legitimate,
293	        outcome.decision,
294	        RatingRule::BlockIsFinding,
295	        note,
296	    ))
297	}
298	
299	fn build_row(
300	    test_id: &'static str,
301	    category: &'static str,
302	    outcome_kind: OutcomeKind,
303	    decision: GateDecision,
304	    rating_rule: RatingRule,
305	    note: &'static str,
306	) -> RobustnessRow {
307	    let passed = matches!(decision, GateDecision::Pass);
308	    RobustnessRow {
309	        test_id,
310	        category,
311	        expectation: expectation_text(outcome_kind),
312	        actual_decision: decision_text(decision).to_owned(),
313	        classification: classify(passed, rating_rule),
314	        note,
315	    }
316	}
317	
318	fn expectation_text(outcome_kind: OutcomeKind) -> &'static str {
319	    match outcome_kind {
320	        OutcomeKind::Legitimate => "legitimate",
321	        OutcomeKind::Illegitimate => "illegitimate",
322	    }
323	}
324	
325	fn decision_text(decision: GateDecision) -> &'static str {
326	    match decision {
327	        GateDecision::Pass => "PASS",
328	        GateDecision::Block => "BLOCK",
329	    }
330	}
331	
332	fn classify(passed: bool, rating_rule: RatingRule) -> &'static str {
333	    match (passed, rating_rule) {
334	        (true, RatingRule::PassIsFinding) => "FINDING",
335	        (false, RatingRule::BlockIsFinding) => "FINDING",
336	        _ => "DESIGN",
337	    }
338	}

===== 9. cross_agent_portability.rs head =====
//! Cross-agent portability replay: round-trip every existing gate scenario
//! through synthetic Cursor/Copilot/generic adapters and assert the gate
//! decision is unchanged. Fully local and scripted; results are DESIGN-tagged
//! because nothing here touches a live third-party agent.
//! Used by: cargo test portability acceptance.

use std::error::Error;

use agentmint::aerf::adapters::copilot::CopilotAdapter;
use agentmint::aerf::adapters::cursor::CursorAdapter;
use agentmint::aerf::adapters::generic::GenericAdapter;
use agentmint::aerf::adapters::{AgentAdapter, CanonicalEvent};
use agentmint::aerf::gate::{
    GateConfig, GateDecision, GateEngine, PlannedResult, TaskScope, ToolCall,
};
use agentmint::aerf::AerfResult;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

type Transform<'a> = dyn Fn(&str, Value) -> AerfResult<(String, Value)> + 'a;

type ScenarioFn = fn(&Transform) -> AerfResult<Vec<GateDecision>>;

struct Scenario {
    name: &'static str,
    run: ScenarioFn,
}

fn call(transform: &Transform, tool: &str, args: Value) -> AerfResult<ToolCall> {
    let (native_tool, native_args) = transform(tool, args)?;
    Ok(ToolCall::new(&native_tool, native_args))
}

#[test]
fn cross_agent_portability_replay() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let scenarios = scenarios();
    let adapters: Vec<Box<dyn AgentAdapter>> = vec![
        Box::new(CursorAdapter),
        Box::new(CopilotAdapter),
        Box::new(GenericAdapter),
    ];

    println!("adapter fidelity:");
    for adapter in &adapters {
        println!(
            "  {} | {} | {}",
            adapter.name(),
            adapter.fidelity().label(),
            adapter.notes()
        );
    }

---------------- OUTPUT ----------------
33	#[test]
34	fn cross_agent_portability_replay() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
35	    let scenarios = scenarios();
36	    let adapters: Vec<Box<dyn AgentAdapter>> = vec![
37	        Box::new(CursorAdapter),
38	        Box::new(CopilotAdapter),
39	        Box::new(GenericAdapter),
40	    ];
41	
42	    println!("adapter fidelity:");
43	    for adapter in &adapters {
44	        println!(
45	            "  {} | {} | {}",
46	            adapter.name(),
47	            adapter.fidelity().label(),
48	            adapter.notes()
49	        );
50	    }
51	    println!();
52	
53	    let identity: Box<Transform> = Box::new(|tool: &str, args: Value| Ok((tool.to_owned(), args)));
54	
55	    println!(
56	        "scenario | canonical decision | Cursor-adapter | Copilot-adapter | generic-adapter | match"
57	    );
58	
59	    let mut mismatches = Vec::new();
60	    let mut per_adapter_matches = vec![0usize; adapters.len()];
61	
62	    for scenario in &scenarios {
63	        let canonical = (scenario.run)(identity.as_ref())?;
64	        let mut adapter_cells = Vec::new();
65	        let mut row_match = true;
66	
67	        for (index, adapter) in adapters.iter().enumerate() {
68	            let round_trip: Box<Transform> = Box::new(move |tool: &str, args: Value| {
69	                let event = adapter.round_trip(&CanonicalEvent::new(tool, args))?;
70	                Ok((event.tool, event.args))
71	            });
72	            let replayed = (scenario.run)(round_trip.as_ref())?;
73	            let matched = replayed == canonical;
74	            if matched {
75	                per_adapter_matches[index] += 1;
76	            } else {
77	                row_match = false;
78	                mismatches.push(format!(
79	                    "{} via {}: canonical {} vs adapter {}",
80	                    scenario.name,
81	                    adapter.name(),
82	                    render(&canonical),
83	                    render(&replayed)
84	                ));
85	            }
86	            adapter_cells.push(render(&replayed));
87	        }
88	
89	        println!(
90	            "{} | {} | {} | {} | {} | {}",
91	            scenario.name,
92	            render(&canonical),
93	            adapter_cells[0],
94	            adapter_cells[1],
95	            adapter_cells[2],
96	            yes_no(row_match)
97	        );
98	    }
99	
100	    println!();
101	    println!("total scenarios: {}", scenarios.len());
102	    for (index, adapter) in adapters.iter().enumerate() {
103	        println!(
104	            "{} match: {}/{}",
105	            adapter.name(),
106	            per_adapter_matches[index],
107	            scenarios.len()
108	        );
109	    }
110	
111	    if mismatches.is_empty() {
112	        println!(
113	            "RESULT: clean match across all {} scenarios and all 3 adapters (DESIGN).",
114	            scenarios.len()
115	        );
116	    } else {
117	        println!("RESULT: {} mismatch(es) detected (DESIGN finding):", mismatches.len());
118	        for mismatch in &mismatches {
119	            println!("  MISMATCH {mismatch}");
120	        }
121	    }
122	
123	    assert!(
124	        mismatches.is_empty(),
125	        "gate decisions diverged after adapter round-trip; the policy logic is coupled to specific field shapes"
126	    );
127	
128	    Ok(())
129	}

1	//! Synthetic cross-agent tool-call adapters that reshape a canonical
2	//! {tool, args} event into an approximate native shape and back.
3	//! Used by: tests/cross_agent_portability.rs.
4	
5	pub mod copilot;
6	pub mod cursor;
7	pub mod generic;
8	
9	use serde_json::{Map, Value};
10	
11	use crate::aerf::AerfResult;
12	
13	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
14	pub struct CanonicalEvent {
15	    pub tool: String,
16	    pub args: Value,
17	}
18	
19	impl CanonicalEvent {
20	    pub fn new(tool: &str, args: Value) -> Self {
21	        Self {
22	            tool: tool.to_owned(),
23	            args,
24	        }
25	    }
26	}
27	
28	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
29	pub enum Fidelity {
30	    Documented,
31	    BestEffortUnverified,
32	}
33	
34	impl Fidelity {
35	    pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {
36	        match self {
37	            Self::Documented => "documented public format",
38	            Self::BestEffortUnverified => "best-effort, unverified against live docs",
39	        }
40	    }
41	}
42	
43	pub trait AgentAdapter {
44	    fn name(&self) -> &'static str;
45	    fn fidelity(&self) -> Fidelity;
46	    fn notes(&self) -> &'static str;
47	    fn to_native(&self, event: &CanonicalEvent) -> AerfResult<Value>;
48	    #[allow(clippy::wrong_self_convention)]
49	    fn from_native(&self, native: &Value) -> AerfResult<CanonicalEvent>;
50	
51	    fn round_trip(&self, event: &CanonicalEvent) -> AerfResult<CanonicalEvent> {
52	        let native = self.to_native(event)?;
53	        self.from_native(&native)
54	    }
55	}
56	
57	pub(crate) struct ToolSchema {
58	    pub canonical: &'static str,
59	    pub native: &'static str,
60	    pub fields: &'static [(&'static str, &'static str)],
61	    pub injected: &'static [(&'static str, &'static str)],
62	}
63	
64	pub(crate) fn by_canonical<'a>(
65	    schemas: &'a [ToolSchema],
66	    canonical: &str,
67	) -> Option<&'a ToolSchema> {
68	    schemas.iter().find(|schema| schema.canonical == canonical)
69	}
70	
71	pub(crate) fn by_native<'a>(schemas: &'a [ToolSchema], native: &str) -> Option<&'a ToolSchema> {
72	    schemas.iter().find(|schema| schema.native == native)
73	}
74	
75	pub(crate) fn native_tool(schema: Option<&ToolSchema>, canonical: &str) -> String {
76	    schema.map(|schema| schema.native.to_owned()).unwrap_or_else(|| canonical.to_owned())
77	}
78	
79	pub(crate) fn canonical_tool(schema: Option<&ToolSchema>, native: &str) -> String {
80	    schema.map(|schema| schema.canonical.to_owned()).unwrap_or_else(|| native.to_owned())
81	}
82	
83	pub(crate) fn to_native_args(schema: Option<&ToolSchema>, args: &Value) -> Value {
84	    let Some(object) = args.as_object() else {
85	        return args.clone();
86	    };
87	    let mut out = Map::new();
88	    for (key, value) in object {
89	        out.insert(rename_to_native(schema, key), value.clone());
90	    }
91	    if let Some(schema) = schema {
92	        for (name, injected) in schema.injected {
93	            out.insert((*name).to_owned(), Value::String((*injected).to_owned()));
94	        }
95	    }
96	    Value::Object(out)
97	}
98	
99	pub(crate) fn from_native_args(schema: Option<&ToolSchema>, args: &Value) -> Value {
100	    let Some(object) = args.as_object() else {
101	        return args.clone();
102	    };
103	    let mut out = Map::new();
104	    for (key, value) in object {
105	        if is_injected(schema, key) {
106	            continue;
107	        }
108	        out.insert(rename_to_canonical(schema, key), value.clone());
109	    }
110	    Value::Object(out)
111	}
112	
113	fn rename_to_native(schema: Option<&ToolSchema>, canonical_field: &str) -> String {
114	    schema
115	        .and_then(|schema| {
116	            schema
117	                .fields
118	                .iter()
119	                .find(|(canonical, _)| *canonical == canonical_field)
120	                .map(|(_, native)| (*native).to_owned())
121	        })
122	        .unwrap_or_else(|| canonical_field.to_owned())
123	}
124	
125	fn rename_to_canonical(schema: Option<&ToolSchema>, native_field: &str) -> String {
126	    schema
127	        .and_then(|schema| {
128	            schema
129	                .fields
130	                .iter()
131	                .find(|(_, native)| *native == native_field)
132	                .map(|(canonical, _)| (*canonical).to_owned())
133	        })
134	        .unwrap_or_else(|| native_field.to_owned())
135	}
136	
137	fn is_injected(schema: Option<&ToolSchema>, native_field: &str) -> bool {
138	    schema.is_some_and(|schema| {
139	        schema.injected.iter().any(|(name, _)| *name == native_field)
140	    })
141	}
142

15	const SCHEMAS: &[ToolSchema] = &[
16	    ToolSchema {
17	        canonical: "read_file",
18	        native: "read_file",
19	        fields: &[("path", "target_file")],
20	        injected: &[],
21	    },
22	    ToolSchema {
23	        canonical: "write_file",
24	        native: "edit_file",
25	        fields: &[("path", "target_file")],
26	        injected: &[("instructions", "synthetic replay edit")],
27	    },
28	    ToolSchema {
29	        canonical: "run_command",
30	        native: "run_terminal_cmd",
31	        fields: &[("command", "command")],
32	        injected: &[("is_background", "false")],
33	    },
34	];
35	
36	pub struct CursorAdapter;
37	
38	impl AgentAdapter for CursorAdapter {
39	    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
40	        "Cursor"
41	    }
42	
43	    fn fidelity(&self) -> Fidelity {
44	        Fidelity::BestEffortUnverified
45	    }
46	
47	    fn notes(&self) -> &'static str {
48	        "run_terminal_cmd/read_file/edit_file field names modeled from observed behavior; git and test tools are not explicitly modeled and pass through"
49	    }
50	
51	    fn to_native(&self, event: &CanonicalEvent) -> AerfResult<Value> {
52	        let schema = by_canonical(SCHEMAS, &event.tool);
53	        Ok(json!({
54	            "type": "tool_call",
55	            "name": native_tool(schema, &event.tool),
56	            "arguments": to_native_args(schema, &event.args)
57	        }))
58	    }
59	
60	    fn from_native(&self, native: &Value) -> AerfResult<CanonicalEvent> {
61	        let name = native.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or_default();
62	        let schema = by_native(SCHEMAS, name);
63	        let arguments = native.get("arguments").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| json!({}));
64	        Ok(CanonicalEvent {
65	            tool: canonical_tool(schema, name),
66	            args: from_native_args(schema, &arguments),
67	        })
68	    }
69	}

17	    ToolSchema {
18	        canonical: "read_file",
19	        native: "read_file",
20	        fields: &[("path", "filePath")],
21	        injected: &[],
22	    },
23	    ToolSchema {
24	        canonical: "write_file",
25	        native: "create_file",
26	        fields: &[("path", "filePath")],
27	        injected: &[("content", "synthetic replay content")],
28	    },
29	    ToolSchema {
30	        canonical: "run_command",
31	        native: "run_in_terminal",

33	        injected: &[("explanation", "synthetic replay"), ("isBackground", "false")],
34	    },

36	
37	pub struct CopilotAdapter;
38	
39	impl AgentAdapter for CopilotAdapter {
40	    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
41	        "Copilot"
42	    }
43	
44	    fn fidelity(&self) -> Fidelity {
45	        Fidelity::BestEffortUnverified
46	    }
47	
48	    fn notes(&self) -> &'static str {
49	        "OpenAI-style function envelope is stable; internal tool names (run_in_terminal/create_file) and field names (filePath) are approximated and unverified"
50	    }
51	
52	    fn to_native(&self, event: &CanonicalEvent) -> AerfResult<Value> {
53	        let schema = by_canonical(SCHEMAS, &event.tool);
54	        let arguments = to_native_args(schema, &event.args);
55	        Ok(json!({
56	            "type": "function",
57	            "function": {
58	                "name": native_tool(schema, &event.tool),
59	                "arguments": serde_json::to_string(&arguments)?
60	            }
61	        }))
62	    }
63	
64	    fn from_native(&self, native: &Value) -> AerfResult<CanonicalEvent> {
65	        let function = native.get("function").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
66	        let name = function.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or_default();
67	        let schema = by_native(SCHEMAS, name);
68	        let arguments = decode_arguments(function)?;
69	        Ok(CanonicalEvent {
70	            tool: canonical_tool(schema, name),
71	            args: from_native_args(schema, &arguments),
72	        })
73	    }
74	}
75	
76	fn decode_arguments(function: &Value) -> AerfResult<Value> {
77	    let Some(raw) = function.get("arguments").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
78	        return Ok(json!({}));
79	    };
80	    Ok(serde_json::from_str(raw)?)
81	}

10	use super::{AgentAdapter, CanonicalEvent, Fidelity};
11	use crate::aerf::AerfResult;
12	
13	pub struct GenericAdapter;
14	
15	impl AgentAdapter for GenericAdapter {
16	    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
17	        "generic"
18	    }
19	
20	    fn fidelity(&self) -> Fidelity {
21	        Fidelity::Documented
22	    }
23	
24	    fn notes(&self) -> &'static str {
25	        "OpenAI function-call envelope is documented and stable; tool and field names pass through verbatim as a stand-in for unmodeled agents"
26	    }
27	
28	    fn to_native(&self, event: &CanonicalEvent) -> AerfResult<Value> {
29	        Ok(json!({
30	            "id": format!("call_{}", event.tool),
31	            "type": "function",
32	            "function": {
33	                "name": event.tool,
34	                "arguments": serde_json::to_string(&event.args)?
35	            }
36	        }))
37	    }
38	
39	    fn from_native(&self, native: &Value) -> AerfResult<CanonicalEvent> {
40	        let function = native.get("function").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
41	        let name = function.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or_default();
42	        let args = match function.get("arguments").and_then(Value::as_str) {
43	            Some(raw) => serde_json::from_str(raw)?,
44	            None => json!({}),
45	        };
46	        Ok(CanonicalEvent::new(name, args))
47	    }
48	}

===== server.rs =====
//! Axum router and server setup with security headers.

use axum::http::header::{self, HeaderValue};
use axum::response::Response;
use axum::routing::{get, post};
use axum::{Router, middleware};
use tower_http::cors::CorsLayer;

use crate::handlers;
use crate::state::AppState;
use crate::webauthn;

async fn security_headers(req: axum::extract::Request, next: middleware::Next) -> Response {
    let mut resp = next.run(req).await;
    let h = resp.headers_mut();
    h.insert(header::X_CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS, HeaderValue::from_static("nosniff"));
    h.insert(header::X_FRAME_OPTIONS, HeaderValue::from_static("DENY"));
    h.insert(header::CACHE_CONTROL, HeaderValue::from_static("no-store"));
    resp
}

pub fn build_router(state: AppState) -> Router {
    Router::new()
        // Core endpoints
        .route("/health", get(handlers::health::health))
        .route("/mint", post(handlers::mint::mint))
        .route("/delegate", post(handlers::delegate::delegate))
        .route("/proxy", post(handlers::proxy::proxy))
        .route("/audit", get(handlers::audit::recent))
        .route("/metrics", get(handlers::metrics::metrics))
        // WebAuthn endpoints
        .route("/webauthn/register/start", post(webauthn::register_start))
        .route("/webauthn/register/finish", post(webauthn::register_finish))
        .route("/webauthn/auth/start", post(webauthn::auth_start))
        .route("/webauthn/auth/finish", post(webauthn::auth_finish))
        // Middleware
        .layer(middleware::from_fn(security_headers))
        .layer(CorsLayer::permissive())
        .with_state(state)
}

pub async fn run(state: AppState, addr: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(addr).await?;
    run_with_listener(state, listener).await
}

pub async fn run_with_listener(state: AppState, listener: tokio::net::TcpListener) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let router = build_router(state);
    tracing::info!("listening on {:?}", listener.local_addr());
    axum::serve(listener, router).await
}

===== error.rs =====
//! Unified error types with secure client messages.

use axum::http::StatusCode;
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum Error {
    #[error("token expired")]
    TokenExpired,

    #[error("invalid signature")]
    InvalidSignature,

    #[error("invalid token: {0}")]
    InvalidToken(String),

    #[error("replay: {0}")]
    ReplayDetected(String),

    #[error("policy: {0}")]
    PolicyViolation(String),

    #[error("unauthorized: {0}")]
    Unauthorized(String),

    #[error("rate limited: {0}")]
    RateLimited(String),

    #[error("validation: {0}")]
    Validation(String),

    #[error("unavailable: {0}")]
    ServiceUnavailable(String),

    #[error("db: {0}")]
    Database(#[from] rusqlite::Error),

    #[error("json: {0}")]
    Serialization(#[from] serde_json::Error),

    #[error("base64: {0}")]
    Base64(#[from] base64::DecodeError),

    #[error("signing: {0}")]
    Signing(String),
}

impl Error {
    fn status(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            Self::TokenExpired | Self::InvalidSignature | Self::InvalidToken(_) | Self::Unauthorized(_) => {
                StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED
            }
            Self::ReplayDetected(_) => StatusCode::CONFLICT,
            Self::PolicyViolation(_) => StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
            Self::RateLimited(_) => StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
            Self::Validation(_) | Self::Base64(_) => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
            Self::ServiceUnavailable(_) => StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
            Self::Database(_) | Self::Serialization(_) | Self::Signing(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    /// Safe message for clients - never leak internals
    fn client_msg(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::TokenExpired => "token expired",
            Self::InvalidSignature => "invalid signature",
            Self::InvalidToken(_) => "invalid token",
            Self::ReplayDetected(_) => "token already used",
            Self::PolicyViolation(_) => "policy violation",
            Self::Unauthorized(_) => "unauthorized",
            Self::RateLimited(_) => "rate limited",
            Self::Validation(_) => "invalid request",
            Self::ServiceUnavailable(_) => "service unavailable",
            Self::Database(_) | Self::Serialization(_) | Self::Signing(_) | Self::Base64(_) => "internal error",
        }
    }
}

impl IntoResponse for Error {
    fn into_response(self) -> Response {
        let status = self.status();
        tracing::warn!(error = %self, status = %status.as_u16(), "request failed");
        (status, self.client_msg()).into_response()
    }
}

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;

pub fn lock_err<T>(name: &str) -> impl FnOnce(std::sync::PoisonError<T>) -> Error + '_ {
    move |_| Error::Signing(format!("{name} lock poisoned"))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn status_codes() {
        assert_eq!(Error::TokenExpired.status(), StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED);
        assert_eq!(Error::ReplayDetected("x".into()).status(), StatusCode::CONFLICT);
        assert_eq!(Error::PolicyViolation("x".into()).status(), StatusCode::FORBIDDEN);
        assert_eq!(Error::RateLimited("x".into()).status(), StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS);
        assert_eq!(Error::ServiceUnavailable("x".into()).status(), StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE);
    }

    #[test]
    fn no_internal_leak() {
        assert_eq!(Error::Database(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows).client_msg(), "internal error");
        assert_eq!(Error::Signing("secret key".into()).client_msg(), "internal error");
    }
}

72	        })
73	    }
74	}
